# Set80 actual exact-request recovery

This external helper is source-authored and unexecuted. Root alone selects the
build/profile/source lock and runs each case. No product flag, fixture signer,
clock override, winning nonce, response cache or live-DB bypass is added.

Invocation is `--case A|B --node ABS --operator ABS --helper ABS --artifacts ABS
--reference ABS --old-reference ABS --base-reference ABS`. The three references
are respectively root-qualified `0f0890e5` (173644 bytes), inherited `a48a854d`,
and inherited `a5c65673`; the selection producer is retained unexecuted-by-agent.
Its root qualification is artifacts/set80/actual-reference-attempt1/report.json.
The complete protocol corpus stays `4bbe4eb9`. Every copied original helper and
public fixture catalog is bound by copied-inputs.json. Source snapshots under
inherited/ and pre-peer-process-relay/ are never rewritten.

Both cases require a separately fresh root containing root-copied original
synthetic schema14 wallet/account fixture and two original normal node homes.
The original schema16 fixture wallet is created from the exact *published*
independent seed, then closed before real standalone operator init/rotate/serve.
No runtime/private fixture is an input to the independent selection producer.
All serving and recoveries run real standalone operator children. The headless
miner uses --daily-recoverable-issue, original local login/Mining/vault custody,
protected credentials and its original selected outbox. Case B's terminal
consumption into a worker remains the separate focused original-worker control;
external B intentionally does not Start a second miner after expiry.

Case A proves one original pending/issued crash gap, exact job/template/proposal,
a successful real TLS work response lost before any response byte, a joined
worker restart on the same null q row, exact successful original-ID replay,
actual recovered-job canonical work, signed original fighter authorizations,
stopped reopen and complete outbox invariance. The unchanged one/two reward
branch then matures before a fixed real UTC due and pays through the original
scheduler/schema16 signer to the original schema14 recipient. It verifies one
broadcast and exact closed ledger/raw/txid/credits/99%-1%/fee/change. See
PERSISTENCE_EVIDENCE.md for the explicitly indirect persistence observation.
Completed work is also looked up/resumed after actual original expiry with no
new hashing or expiry renewal. Later legitimately generated request IDs may be
retained; every request/job/work/inverse is fully audited, and the recovered
original request/job is compared exactly across every phase.

Case B proves the same gap on an independent fresh root, waits for real expiry,
then resolves the same authenticated request to issued_unused with the exact
old job and expired_before_work. Lookup and Resume retain the identical terminal.
Closed full original audits require no work, share, birth, round, credit, batch,
broadcast or chain-height advance. The stopped local null request remains exact.

Each case has one 900-second root scenario context, no renewal, maximum180 blocks,
and one due chosen at initial start plus7 minutes (minute truncation), even for
B. Existing product operations retain30-second bounds. Root's outer proposed
watchdog remains1080 seconds. A proposal ack must be followed by exactly one
SIGKILL of that original operator within5 seconds. It is recorded as intentional
crash/reap, never a clean Close. Other serving/operator/CLI owners require exact
SIGTERM/zero exits and joined output; one-shot init/rotate requires its own
normal zero exit. All children remain in the original parent-owned process group.
Both nodes/relays remain parent-owned; uncertain ownership and original trees are
retained on failure. No failed attempt is automatically restarted until lucky.

The TLS front listener is the immutable selected Origin; backend ingress Listen
is a separately selected loopback socket. Both use the same original certificate
and strictTLS1.3 and preserve the original Host. The RPC relay holds only a real
successful proposal response with the matching original bounded RPC ID. Closed
read-only original audits prove the gap and exact captured candidate. The TLS
relay never serves cached work: the successful withheld bytes are correlation
evidence; the original server must independently return the identical response.

Public evidence is phase JSON, bounded process logs, selected setup/remote
public values, exact request/result/job/template, full selected audit counts and
row hashes, original outbox control hashes, actual payment/raw and final cleanup.
Bearer/RPC secrets, seed files, wallet DBs and private-fixture contents are never
public evidence. This finite proof does not claim continuous capacity, public
hosting, changed authentication, revised economics or D74 completion.
